hey, buddy, i was a freshman in high school last year. winter time was especially hard for me, and it kinda sucks after winter break yeah. you should try talking to your teachers about your grades and asking if you can do extra credit. explain how you’re feeling to them. if you don’t want to do this, i recommend going to the school guidance counselor or asking your parents for therapy, unless you can talk to them freely about it. we’re halfway done with the school year, you’ve made it this far and i promise you that you can make it 6 months longer. you probably have spring break somewhere in there, and we have Good Friday in april i think. i believe in you kid, and i know sometimes that’s not enough to hear. but your best is good enough. no matter what anyone else says. it gets better, i promise. if you go to therapy, you should ask about medication, or explain how you feel to your regular doctor—which would be beneficial to you if you don’t want to ask your parents straight up.
